Figure 6 uses the original modality-specific DiffBind results and module/GO enrichment tables. The original DiffBind workflow, the two effect measures, enrichment counting units and expression normalization are included below. Volcano colors retain the original P values and FDR; their x coordinate is the normalized concentration difference, not the DiffBind Fold coefficient.

The available original Figure 6f analysis yields 484 downregulated and 250 upregulated gene–peak overlaps. This counting unit and these outputs are retained explicitly; they do not reproduce the final artwork labels 362/281. This unresolved correspondence is documented in `DATA_AVAILABILITY.md` rather than resolved by changing thresholds.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source("R/common.R")
repo_dir <- REPO
if (!exists("params", inherits = FALSE)) params <- list()
if (is.null(params$run_diffbind)) params$run_diffbind <- FALSE
if (is.null(params$check_statistics)) params$check_statistics <- FALSE

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = TRUE,
  error = FALSE)
```


## Differential chromatin analysis from BAMs

The original DiffBind workflow is included below: modality-matched master peak sets, expansion by 5 kb total (2.5 kb per side), separate Flashtag-positive/negative contrasts, no summit recentering, count filter 0, default DiffBind normalization, Treatment expr versus ctrl and the DESeq2 backend. All results are exported with `th=1`, retaining unfiltered P/FDR fields. BAMs are external inputs, supplied through `CORTEX_BAM_DIR`. The default figure export loads the original differential tables.

```{r native-diffbind, eval=isTRUE(params$run_diffbind)}
library(DiffBind)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(IRanges)
library(dplyr)
catalog_dir <- file.path(REPO, "data", "upstream", "final_tables")
atac <- read.csv(file.path(catalog_dir, "Supp_Table_1_ATAC_master.csv"))
ac <- read.csv(file.path(catalog_dir, "Supp_Table_2_AC_master.csv"))
me3 <- read.csv(file.path(catalog_dir, "Supp_Table_3_ME3_master.csv"))
sample_sheet <- read.csv(file.path(
  REPO, "data", "upstream", "diffbind", "sample_metadata.csv"
), check.names = FALSE)
bam_dir <- Sys.getenv("CORTEX_BAM_DIR")
stopifnot(nzchar(bam_dir), dir.exists(bam_dir))
for (column in intersect(c("bamReads", "bamControl"), names(sample_sheet))) {
  present <- !is.na(sample_sheet[[column]]) & nzchar(sample_sheet[[column]])
  sample_sheet[[column]][present] <- file.path(bam_dir, sample_sheet[[column]][present])
}
out_dir <- file.path(REPO, "objects", "DiffBind", "recomputed")
peaks_outdir <- file.path(out_dir, "peaks")
dir.create(peaks_outdir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE)

make_peaks_gr_from_df <- function(df,
                                  expand_bed = 0L,
                                  seq_col   = "seqnames",
                                  start_col = "start",
                                  end_col   = "end") {
  stopifnot(all(c(seq_col, start_col, end_col) %in% names(df)))

  gr <- GRanges(
    seqnames = df[[seq_col]],
    ranges   = IRanges(start = df[[start_col]], end = df[[end_col]]),

    strand   = "*"
  )

  expand_bed <- as.integer(expand_bed)
  if (!is.na(expand_bed) && expand_bed > 0L) {
    new_widths <- width(gr) + expand_bed
    gr <- resize(gr,
      width = new_widths,
      fix = "center")
    start(gr)[start(gr) < 1L] <- 1L
  }

  mcols(gr)$name  <- paste0("peak", seq_along(gr))
  mcols(gr)$score <- 1L

  gr
}

build_peak_set <- function(PeakSet = c("me3", "ac", "atac"),
                           expand_bed = 0L,
                           peaks_outdir) {
  PeakSet <- tolower(match.arg(PeakSet))

  df <- switch(
    PeakSet,
    atac = atac,
    ac   = ac,
    me3  = me3
  )

  gr <- make_peaks_gr_from_df(df, expand_bed = expand_bed)

  suffix   <- if (expand_bed > 0L) paste0("_exp", expand_bed, "bp") else ""
  bed_name <- paste0(PeakSet, "_peaks", suffix, ".bed")
  bed_path <- file.path(peaks_outdir, bed_name)

  rtracklayer::export(gr, bed_path, format = "BED")

  list(gr = gr,
    path = bed_path)
}

run_diffbind <- function(sample_sheet,
                         contrast_name,
                         out_dir,
                         Modality        = "H3K27Me3",
                         PeakSet         = c("me3", "ac", "atac"),
                         expand_bed      = 0L,
                         ConditionFilter = NULL) {

  PeakSet <- tolower(match.arg(PeakSet))

  ## Filter by Modality and tissue (all ChIP-seq datasets of interest are Cortex)
  sample_sheet <- sample_sheet %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Modality == !!Modality,
      Dissection_Tissue == "Cortex"
    )

  ## Optional filter by Condition: "FlashtagNeg" or "FlashtagPos"
  if (!is.null(ConditionFilter)) {
    sample_sheet <- sample_sheet %>%
      dplyr::filter(Condition == !!ConditionFilter)
  }

  if (nrow(sample_sheet) == 0L) {
    message("Skipping ", contrast_name,
            " (no samples after Modality / Condition / Tissue filters).")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  ## Build chosen peak set
  peak_info <- build_peak_set(
    PeakSet      = PeakSet,
    expand_bed   = expand_bed,
    peaks_outdir = peaks_outdir
  )

  sample_sheet <- sample_sheet %>%
    mutate(Peaks = peak_info$path) %>%
    dplyr::filter(file.exists(bamReads))

  if (nrow(sample_sheet) == 0L) {
    message("Skipping ", contrast_name, " (no samples with existing BAMs).")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  cond_label <- if (is.null(ConditionFilter)) "All" else ConditionFilter

  message("Running DiffBind for: ", contrast_name,
          " | Modality = ", Modality,
          " | PeakSet = ", PeakSet,
          " | expand_bed = ", expand_bed,
          " | Condition = ", cond_label)

  ## --- DiffBind pipeline ---------------------------------------------------
  dba_obj <- dba(sampleSheet = sample_sheet)

  ## These options often help avoid 'error writing to connection'
  ## on Windows / when parallel or summarizeOverlaps misbehaves
  dba_obj <- dba.count(
    dba_obj,
    summits               = FALSE,
    filter                = 0,
    bUseSummarizeOverlaps = FALSE,  # use older counting instead of summarizeOverlaps
    bParallel             = FALSE   # avoid parallel cluster / connection issues
  )

  dba_obj <- dba.normalize(dba_obj)

  dba_obj <- dba.contrast(
    dba_obj,
    contrast = c("Treatment", "expr", "ctrl"),
    name1    = "Kdm6b_expr",
    name2    = "Kdm6b_ctrl"
  )

  print(dba.show(dba_obj, bContrasts = TRUE))

  dba_obj <- dba.analyze(dba_obj, method = DBA_DESEQ2)

  res <- dba.report(
    dba_obj,
    contrast    = 1,
    th          = 1,
    bCounts     = TRUE,
    bNormalized = TRUE
  )

  res_df <- as.data.frame(res)

  ## Build output file name with run parameters, including Condition
  out_file <- file.path(
    out_dir,
    paste0(
      contrast_name,
      "_Modality_", Modality,
      "_PeakSet_", PeakSet,
      "_expand_bed_", expand_bed,
      "_Condition_", cond_label,
      "__genotype_DBA_DESEQ2.csv"
    )
  )

  write.csv(
    res_df,
    file      = out_file,
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  invisible(dba_obj)
}

for (condition in c("FlashtagNeg", "FlashtagPos")) {
  suffix <- if (condition == "FlashtagNeg") "FTneg" else "FTpos"
  for (modality in c("ATAC", "H3K27Ac", "H3K27Me3")) {
    selected_samples <- sample_sheet[
      sample_sheet$Modality == modality &
        sample_sheet$Condition == condition &
        sample_sheet$Dissection_Tissue == "Cortex",
      , drop = FALSE
    ]
    stopifnot(nrow(selected_samples) > 0)
    stopifnot(all(file.exists(selected_samples$bamReads)))
    peak_set <- switch(modality,
      ATAC = "atac",
      H3K27Ac = "ac",
      H3K27Me3 = "me3")
    run_diffbind(
      sample_sheet = sample_sheet,
      contrast_name = paste(if (modality == "H3K27Ac") "Ac" else modality, suffix, sep = "_"),

      out_dir = out_dir,
      Modality = modality,
      PeakSet = peak_set,
      expand_bed = 5000L,
      ConditionFilter = condition
    )
  }
}
```
## Module enrichment from saved counting units

The hypergeometric universe is defined by background peaks, not genes or interaction records. For each module, the one-sided upper-tail probability is computed from its selected/background counts, and Benjamini–Hochberg adjustment is applied over the tested modules.

```{r upstream-module-enrichment-from-saved-counting-units, eval=isTRUE(params$check_statistics)}
enrichment <- read.csv(
  file.path(repo_dir, "data", "source_tables", "Fig6_KC", "6e_Module_enrichment.csv")
)
calculated_p <- phyper(
  q = enrichment$Selected_peaks - 1,
  m = enrichment$Background_peaks,
  n = enrichment$Background_total -
    enrichment$Background_peaks,
    k = enrichment$Selected_total,
    lower.tail = FALSE
)
calculated_fdr <- p.adjust(calculated_p, method = "BH")
stopifnot(
  isTRUE(all.equal(calculated_p, enrichment$Hypergeometric_P, tolerance = 1e-10))
)
stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(calculated_fdr, enrichment$BH_FDR, tolerance = 1e-10)))
head(
  enrichment[, c("Module_figure", "Fold_enrichment", "Hypergeometric_P", "BH_FDR")]
)
```

## RPKM counting convention

Displayed RPKM values are derived from raw counts, gene lengths and the sum of gene counts in each library. These are descriptive expression values; the original RNA differential statistics are retained separately and are not inferred from RPKM.

```{r upstream-rpkm-counting-convention, eval=isTRUE(params$check_statistics)}
expression <- read.csv(file.path(repo_dir, "data", "source_tables", "Fig6_KC", "6o_RPKM.csv"))
calculated_rpkm <- as.double(expression$Raw_count) *
  1e+09/(as.double(expression$Gene_length_bp) *
  as.double(expression$Library_sum_gene_counts))
stopifnot(
  max(abs(calculated_rpkm - expression$RPKM)) <
    1e-08
)
```


## Checkpoint-based figure export

The sections below use the verified saved results. Rerun outputs above are written separately and do not replace these inputs automatically.

## Authoritative bulk-RNA sample metadata

The explicit sample table in `GEO_submission.Rmd` defines the cell populations. Sorting-name suffixes reverse between litters: litter 1 minus libraries are VZ/FTpos, whereas litter 2 plus libraries are VZ/FTpos. The portable `sample_metadata.csv` retains all 15 libraries used in that analysis, including sex determined from RNA. Do not infer cell population from the filename alone. Plot all available sample values; the boxplot's duplicate outlier symbols are suppressed only because the separate point layer displays every observation.

```{r bulk-rna-authoritative-sample-metadata}
bulk_metadata <- read.csv(file.path(REPO, "data/upstream/RNA/sample_metadata.csv"))
stopifnot(nrow(bulk_metadata) == 15, !anyDuplicated(bulk_metadata$Sample))
with(bulk_metadata, table(FlashTag_population, Genotype))
```

## Recorded RPKM normalization from the author workflow

This code follows the featureCounts/DGEList/rpkm block in `GEO_submission.Rmd`. Library sizes use all assigned gene counts. No expression filter or TMM normalization is inserted before RPKM. Execution is optional because the verified plotting tables are already saved.

```{r bulk-rna-recorded-rpkm-normalization, eval=FALSE}
counts <- read.delim(
  file.path(REPO, "data/upstream/RNA/featureCounts_final_15samples.txt"),
  comment.char = "#", check.names = FALSE
)
metadata <- read.csv(file.path(REPO, "data/upstream/RNA/sample_metadata.csv"))
sample_columns <- vapply(metadata$Sample, function(sample) {
  hit <- which(grepl(paste0(sample, "_Aligned"), names(counts), fixed = TRUE))
  stopifnot(length(hit) == 1)
  hit
}, integer(1))
expression_counts <- as.matrix(counts[, sample_columns])
rownames(expression_counts) <- counts$Geneid
colnames(expression_counts) <- metadata$Sample
stopifnot(all(expression_counts >= 0), all(counts$Length > 0))
dge <- edgeR::DGEList(counts = expression_counts)
rpkm_matrix <- edgeR::rpkm(dge, gene.length = counts$Length, log = FALSE)
```

## Figure 6c and Extended Figure 8e volcanoes

No differential model fitting; plot the original saved coordinates and significance categories.

```{r figure-6c-and-extended-figure-8e-volcanoes-3}
for (ft in c("FTpos", "FTneg")) {
  d <- read_table("Fig6_KC", paste0("6c_ME3_", ft))
  stopifnot(max(d$neg_log10_P, na.rm = TRUE) <= 18.5)
  export_panel(
    volcano(d) +
      scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 5, 10, 15)) +
      coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 18.5), expand = FALSE) +
      labs(title = if (ft == "FTpos") "FlashTag-positive" else "FlashTag-negative") +
      theme(
        legend.position = "none",
        plot.title = element_text(size = 8),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 7),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 8)
      ),
    paste0("Fig6/6c_ME3_", ft),
    2.2, 2.6
  )
  for (a in c("atac", "ac", "me3")) {
    d <- read_table("Extended_Fig8_KC", paste0("8e_", a, "_", ft))
    export_panel(
      volcano(d),
      paste0("Ext8/8e_", a, "_", ft),
      5, 4
    )
  }
}
```

## Figure 6d/e and Extended Figure 8g/h enrichment

Preserve original enrichment values, biological universe and BH adjustment.

```{r figure-6d-e-and-extended-figure-8g-h-enrichment-4}
for (b in c("Fig6_KC", "Extended_Fig8_KC")) {
  prefix <- if (b == "Fig6_KC")
    "6" else "8"
  pdir <- if (b == "Fig6_KC")
    "Fig6" else "Ext8"
  s <- if (b == "Fig6_KC")
    "6e_Module_enrichment" else "8h_Module_enrichment"
  d <- read_table(b, s)
  p <- ggplot(d, aes(Module_figure, Fold_enrichment, color = neg_log10_FDR)) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    scale_color_gradient(low = "grey75",
      high = "#B2182B") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1,
      linetype = 2) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90,
      hjust = 1)) +
    labs(x = NULL,
      y = "Fold enrichment")
  export_panel(
    p, paste0(pdir, "/", s),
    8, 4
  )
  s <- if (b == "Fig6_KC")
    "6d_GO_plotted" else "8g_GO_plotted"
  d <- read_table(b, s)
  export_panel(
    ggplot(
      d, aes(
        reorder(name, max_FE),
        max_FE
      )
    ) +
      geom_col(fill = "#6699AA") +
      coord_flip() + labs(x = NULL, y = "Maximum fold enrichment"),

    paste0(pdir, "/", s),
    8, 5
  )
}
```

## Figure 6f saved donut

Retain the original gene–peak overlap unit; do not relabel these totals as unique genes or final artwork counts.

```{r figure-6f-saved-donut-5}
d <- read_table("Fig6_KC", "6f_Gene_peak_counts")
d <- d %>%
  group_by(RNA_direction) %>%
  mutate(Plot_fraction = Gene_peak_overlap_count / sum(Gene_peak_overlap_count)) %>%
  ungroup()
stopifnot(
  sum(d$Gene_peak_overlap_count[d$RNA_direction == "Downregulated"]) == 484, sum(d$Gene_peak_overlap_count[d$RNA_direction == "Upregulated"]) == 250
)
p <- ggplot(d,
  aes(x = 2, y = Plot_fraction, fill = Peak_class)) +
  geom_col(width = 1,
    color = "white") +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  xlim(0.5, 2.5) +
  facet_wrap(~RNA_direction) +
  theme_void() + scale_fill_manual(values = c(`Fold <= 0.5` = "grey80", `Fold > 0.5` = "#4477AA")) +
  labs(
    title = "Recovered analysis: 484 down / 250 up gene<U+2013>peak overlaps"
  )
export_panel(
  p, "Fig6/6f_donut_recovered_analysis", 7, 4, note = "Recovered original analysis, not final Illustrator totals 362/281; gene<U+2013>peak overlap counting unit"
)
```

## Extended Figure 8f interval overlap

ATAC-side overlap is 823 intervals and ME3-side overlap is 821 intervals. These different counts reflect many-to-many intersections. Display original set sizes without forcing an invalid symmetric Euler intersection.

```{r extended-figure-8f-interval-overlap-6}
d <- read_table("Extended_Fig8_KC", "8f_Overlap_counts")
print(d)
z <- data.frame(
  Set = c("ATAC", "ME3 up"),
  Total = c(d$ATAC_total, d$ME3_up_total),
  Overlapping = c(d$ATAC_overlapping_ME3, d$Unique_ME3_overlapping_ATAC)
)
z$Nonoverlapping <- z$Total - z$Overlapping
z <- pivot_longer(
  z, c(Overlapping, Nonoverlapping),
  names_to = "Class",
  values_to = "Intervals"
)
export_panel(
  ggplot(z, aes(Set, Intervals, fill = Class)) +
    geom_col() + scale_fill_manual(values = c(Overlapping = "#8877AA", Nonoverlapping = "grey80")),

  "Ext8/8f_interval_overlap", 4, 4, note = "Side-specific unique interval overlap counts; replaces geometric Euler area approximation"
)
```
